profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Home Chef
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer with 6+ years building and optimizing customer-facing web applications across e-commerce and digital marketing. Specializes in backend performance engineering, query rewrites, API optimization, and infrastructure upgrades that reduce latency and improve system reliability at scale. Owns complex technical epics from scoping through delivery. Mentors junior engineers and contributes to cross-team architectural decisions.
